stops.title: claim
stops.note: The first state takes the item and marks it as being fixed. It always moves on to fix.

parts.note: A computer step: set the status, then hand over to the fix state.

stops.title: fix
stops.note: The loop of the machine. An agent writes a change, a check runs on it, and the result decides where to go next.

parts.note: Count the try. The count is what the retry guard reads.
The agent step. The prompt it receives is a separate snippet you can open with p.
Run the checks. Passing goes to commit; failing goes back to fix until the tenth try, then to gave-up.

stops.title: fix prompt
stops.note: The prompt for the agent step. Its values come from earlier steps.

stops.title: commit
stops.note: Record the fixed change on the item. The machine ends here.

stops.title: gave up
stops.note: Too many failed tries: give up and record why.
